title: If I were a teenager today, I wouldn’t “study” AI. I’d train with it....
description: If I were a teenager today, I wouldn’t “study” AI. I’d train with it. I’d use it like a mental gym. Every day. Explaining business ideas. Planning my day. Prepping for interviews. Breaking down things I don’t understand. Podcast at lunch. A quick case study before bed. A short reflection at night. That’s not theory. That’s exactly what my own kids are doing. Start early. Stay curious. Use AI like a mentor. Most people your age won’t do this. And that’s why it compounds. #aieducation #futureofwork #learnsmart #highvalueskills #nextgeneration #businessmindset #lifeskills #personaldevelopment #technologytips
transcript: Nobody is teaching teenagers how to actually use AI. So here's what I do. If I were you, I would use AI like a mental gym and I'd use it every single day. I'd ask Chat G P t to explain different business models and pretend that it's your favorite entrepreneur. Get it to plan your day or prep for job interviews or break down these big ideas or whatever you're into. While you're walking to school, I'd be listening to an AI podcast. At lunch, I'd be reading a two minute case study on AI. Before bed, I'd be reflecting with chat GPT and asking it to go over things like what did I learn or what do I still need explanations on or what didn't quite click? And look, I'm not guessing here. My own kids are already doing this. They've already started learning high value skills. They've made money and they've got thousands saved. I haven't given them a penny and they're all under the age of 10. They just started early, stayed curious and used AI like a mentor that's been designed to help them achieve pretty much anything they're serious about. The good news is most people your age aren't doing any of this. So if you start now, you're not just getting ahead, you're building a superpower that's going to compound.
